stem: A sweet shop in Lahore packs a box of 36 sweets, each either gulab jamun or barfi. If one sweet is selected at random from the full box, the probability that it is barfi is \(\frac{4}{9}\). If 4 barfi are removed from the box, what is the probability that a sweet selected at random from the remaining sweets is barfi?
solution: After 4 barfi are removed, there are \(16 - 4 = 12\) barfi among \(36 - 4 = 32\) sweets.
verify:
barfi = Rational(4, 9) * 36
assert barfi == 16
p = (barfi - 4) / (36 - 4)
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == [p] == [Rational(3, 8)]
